text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's this way, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm telling you that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a shopping mall we stopped by on the way back from our outing,
I spotted an unusual duo.
They seemed to be troubled by something—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! What are you doing?
The gift corner... does that mean
you're picking out a present for someone?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Wah! Wh-what's all of a sudden?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You looked like you were in trouble.
I might not look it, but I know all about trends.
I thought maybe I could help out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Then please take over. I'm tired of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Hayahide beat her personal best, so when I came looking for a present—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Running right into someone who was thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...It'd suck if we got the same one.
I just thought it'd be better if we bought them together."
choice_data_list: So you ran into trouble because you couldn't agree on things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, then how about we start by looking at the presents each of us thought were good?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Sis loves bananas, after all.
If it's a present, bananas would be the way to go."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, having what you like is always better!
I think it's great, so what's wrong with it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Apparently, it's 'not right now.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so 'not right now' means...
Oh, were you being considerate about my weight or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm in such great shape I might hit a personal best! It'd be terrible if snacks made me gain weight and threw off my groove!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In other words, it was Taishin's way of being nice~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
I just don't want it to go to waste!
That's all you need to know, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that black outfit
might be nice, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
It looks pretty mature, but don't you think it'd suit Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...This is a celebration, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Since it's a celebration,
you're wondering if a brighter outfit would be better?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But~, since there's no alternative proposal, we can't strongly deny it either, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was a difference in talent, but...
I see now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with Mejiro Palmer acting as a mediator,
they worked out their differing opinions...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your purchase!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad that's all settled.
Hayahide is definitely gonna love it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... This would definitely help Hayahide, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Now that I think about it, it almost feels too ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Won't it be fine?
I mean, you both thought it through seriously before choosing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You always praised the performance of this hair styling product, and it won't get in the way of racing!
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Your feelings for them
will surely be conveyed through a gift."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeah, case closed!
All's well that ends well!!
choice_data_list: You were a splendid mediator, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
I really didn't do anything special, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It turns out both of them had felt the same way
about Hayahide right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I just made the opinions
of those two easier to understand!"
choice_data_list: That's not an easy thing to pull off.
That's not something just anyone can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I just made the opinions
of those two easier to understand!"
choice_data_list: That's not an easy thing to pull off.
That's not something just anyone can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Laying on the praise, are we?
Even someone like Palmer gets embarrassed, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, by that logic,
doesn't that make you amazing too, Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: After all, you're guiding me so I don't lose my way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chatting pleasantly like that,
the two headed home together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ! Ahaha, this is kinda exciting. Since I'm usually the one learning from you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you're going that far~... are you gonna start calling me Professor Palmer from now on!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, forget what I just said!
That's so not on my level, it's embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Now, now~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that exchange between them,
the two headed on their way home.
